2607.01709.title: COMFYCLAW: Self-Evolving Skill Harnesses for Image Generation Workflows
2607.01709.paper_summary: Agents are increasingly used to construct workflows and assist humans in completing recurring tasks more efficiently. As these workflows become repeated and domain-specific, agent memory and reusable skills become increasingly important: agents should be able to recall workflow patterns, execution constraints, and user preferences from previous runs. We study this problem in workflow-based image generation and introduce COMFYCLAW, an agentic skill evolution harness for controlling ComfyUI workflows. COMFYCLAW formulates workflow construction as typed graph editing, exposes tools organized by construction stage, automatically reverts invalid edits, and uses a region-level vision-language model (VLM) verifier to translate visual failures into actionable repair suggestions. The framework further evolves a progressively disclosed skill library, where trajectories, execution errors, and verifier feedback from previous runs are distilled into reusable Agent Skills. Across four benchmark splits, three agent models, and two image backbones, COMFYCLAW achieves the best average image-generation evaluation score across all six agent configurations, outperforming a verifier-only baseline without skill evolution. Human annotations further show that annotators prefer COMFYCLAW over variants without skill evolution. Our results suggest that skill evolution is an effective mechanism for improving agent reliability and performance in recurring visual workflow construction.
2607.01709.paper_summary_zh: 代理人越來越多地被用來構建工作流程，並協助人類更有效地完成重複性任務。隨著這些工作流程變得重複且特定於領域，代理人的記憶和可重用技能變得越來越重要：代理人應能夠從之前的運行中回憶起工作流程模式、執行限制和用戶偏好。我們在基於工作流程的圖像生成中研究這個問題，並介紹了 COMFYCLAW，一種用於控制 ComfyUI 工作流程的代理技能演變工具。COMFYCLAW 將工作流程構建公式化為類型化圖編輯，並提供按構建階段組織的工具，自動撤銷無效編輯，並使用區域級視覺-語言模型 (VLM) 驗證器將視覺失敗轉換為可行的修復建議。該框架進一步發展出一個逐步披露的技能庫，其中來自之前運行的軌跡、執行錯誤和驗證器反饋被提煉為可重用的代理技能。在四個基準拆分、三個代理模型和兩個圖像骨幹之間，COMFYCLAW 在所有六個代理配置中實現了最佳的平均圖像生成評估分數，超越了僅使用驗證器的基線而沒有技能演變。人類註釋進一步顯示，註釋者更喜歡 COMFYCLAW 而不是沒有技能演變的變體。我們的結果表明，技能演變是一種有效的機制，可以提高代理人在重複視覺工作流程構建中的可靠性和性能。
